title: Sneaky Snitch
blurb: Kevin MacLeod's Sneaky Snitch is the pizzicato caper theme that soundtracks every act of cartoon mischief on YouTube: tiptoeing, pilfering, plotting, getting clean away with it. MacLeod released hundreds of tracks under Creative Commons licences and in the process accidentally scored an entire era of internet video, and this is far and away the most recognisable of the lot. If you have ever watched somebody do something they should not, you have heard it. Play it while doing something you should not.
origin: 'Sneaky Snitch' by Kevin MacLeod, a Creative Commons staple of YouTube video.
